facts.fact: Yorunoyo 2026 runs December 4–30 daily 17:00–21:05, free. Osanbashi is a main viewpoint and projection venue; Zō-no-hana Park is explicitly a light-and-sound waterfront area. The synchronized city spectacle lasts five minutes, but no unverified repeat frequency is asserted. The market and Gate end earlier, December 25.
